title: DashboardCommon
description: Shared building blocks of the dashboard contracts (AGB-1084): ids, time, language and the error envelope. No OS or path style is assumed.

DashboardId.title: DashboardId
DashboardId.description: An opaque id: a user subject (usr_...), a client-made event id, a note id.

DashboardTime.title: DashboardTime
DashboardTime.description: An ISO 8601 date-time with an offset.

DashboardLanguage.title: DashboardLanguage
DashboardLanguage.description: The five platform languages, in presentation order.

DashboardApiError.title: DashboardApiError
DashboardApiError.description: Error body. `code` is one of dashboard-errors.json or a shared registry code. No child data and no PIN ever appears in `message` or `details`.
